description: The shape a stock Ubuntu has: a vendor file sets kernel.kptr_restrict = 1, and /proc holds the same value. Both halves of the pair pass it since catalog 33 — 1 hides pointers from every unprivileged reader, and what it leaves open needs CAP_SYSLOG. Until then KERNEL-0018 failed it at MEDIUM while KERNEL-0002 passed it, which is the contradiction the runtime/persistence audit closed. dmesg_restrict is set correctly beside it, so the two leak checks stay independent.
